items.title: 18.10.1 Tezaabi manganate(VII) ions ka ethanedioate ions se reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.10.1, printed page 30.

blocks.text: Misal ke tor par acidified (tezabi) MnO₄⁻ aur C₂O₄²⁻ ka reaction lein. Dono half-reactions ke standard reduction potentials ka muqabla karte hain. Jis half-reaction ka E° zyada musbat ho us ke reduce hone (daen taraf chalne) ka imkaan zyada hai. E° values ke mutabiq MnO₄⁻ reduce ho kar Mn²⁺ banta hai (oxidizing agent), aur C₂O₄²⁻ oxidize ho kar CO₂ banta hai (reducing agent).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is half-reaction ka E° +0.49 V chhaapti hai; data tables CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ couple ke liye taqreeban −0.49 V dete hain (carbon dioxide oxidizing agent nahi hai). Yahan sahi qeemat −0.49 V di gayi hai.

Jis reaction ka reduction potential zyada ho woh hone aur daen taraf chalne ka zyada imkaan rakhta hai, aur ulat bhi. In values ke mutabiq Mn(VII) ion reduce ho kar Mn(II) banta hai (oxidizing agent), jab ke oxalate oxidize ho kar CO₂ banta hai (reducing agent).

Khoye gaye electrons ki tadaad hasil kiye gaye electrons ke barabar honi chahiye. Is ke liye dono half reactions ko mukhtalif numbers se zarb dete hain: reduction half equation (MnO₄⁻, 5 electrons) ko 2 se aur oxidation half equation (C₂O₄²⁻, 2 electrons) ko 5 se, taa ke dono taraf 10 electrons hon.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke oxidation half equation ko 2 aur reduction half equation ko 5 se zarb diya; yeh ulta hai. Sahi: reduction (MnO₄⁻) × 2 aur oxidation (C₂O₄²⁻) × 5. Kitab ki apni working mein bhi MnO₄⁻ wali line × 2 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kul equation 2MnO₄⁻ + 5C₂O₄²⁻ + 8H⁺ → 5Mn²⁺ + 2CO₂ + 8H₂O aur E°cell = +1.03 V chhaapti hai. Yeh balanced nahi (Mn, C aur H barabar nahi). Sahi: 2MnO₄⁻ + 16H⁺ + 5C₂O₄²⁻ → 2Mn²⁺ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O, aur E°cell = 1.52 − (−0.49) = +2.01 V. Dono soorton mein reaction feasible hai.
Musbat net E° value batati hai ke forward (aage ka) reaction feasible hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Electron ginti: 2 × 5 = 10 electrons MnO₄⁻ lete hain aur 5 × 2 = 10 electrons C₂O₄²⁻ dete hain. H⁺: 2 × 8 = 16; H₂O: 2 × 4 = 8; CO₂: 5 × 2 = 10. E°cell = E°reduction − E°oxidation = 1.52 − (−0.49) = +2.01 V. E° ko zarb nahi kiya jata.

blocks.prompt: MnO₄⁻ aur C₂O₄²⁻ ke reaction mein reducing agent kaun hai aur woh kis mein oxidize hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanedioate (oxalate) ion, C₂O₄²⁻; yeh carbon dioxide (CO₂) mein oxidize hota hai.

items: MnO₄⁻ (+1.52 V) reduce ho kar Mn²⁺; C₂O₄²⁻ oxidize ho kar CO₂.
